name: Portage County, OH
findings: Portage County has 531 nonprofit organizations. 229 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 193 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Portage County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 2 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 25 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Portage County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
